heading: Dru Sjodin National Sex Offender Public Website

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: There is established the Dru Sjodin National Sex Offender Public Website (hereinafter in this section referred to as the “Website”), which the Attorney General shall maintain.

tree.heading: Information to be provided
tree.text: The Website shall include relevant information for each sex offender and other person listed on a jurisdiction’s Internet site. The Website shall allow the public to obtain relevant information for each sex offender by a single query for any given zip code or geographical radius set by the user in a form and with such limitations as may be established by the Attorney General and shall have such other field search capabilities as the Attorney General may provide.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The Dru Sjodin National Sex Offender Public Website, referred to in text, is located at https://www.nsopw.gov.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 16920 of Title 42, The Public Health and Welfare, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
